title: Where the Arm Loses a Direction: Singular Values, Three Kinds of Singularity, and a Line Drawn Over the Shoulder

artifact.note: the singular values of a six row Jacobian (the square roots of the eigenvalues of J J transpose by the Jacobi method), manipulability and the condition number, the smallest singular value as the distance from a singularity, the damping that grows as it falls (zero above a threshold, rising to a maximum), and a resolved rate run of the tool along a straight line with fixed orientation, with the peak joint rate and the tracking error it costs
